offering_description.value: Develops, manufactures and commercializes therapies for rare genetic and endocrine diseases. Sells prescription enzyme replacement therapies, a gene therapy and peptide-based drugs to hospitals, specialty pharmacies and distributors worldwide.

primary_products.value: enzyme replacement therapies; peptide therapy for achondroplasia; gene therapy for hemophilia A; PKU treatment; endocrine therapies

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, specialty pharmacies, wholesalers and distributors purchasing rare disease drugs; B2G: government-funded health systems and national payers in international markets

end_markets.value: rare genetic diseases; endocrinology; metabolic disorders; skeletal conditions; hemophilia

revenue_model.value: product sales: prescription rare disease therapies sold to specialty pharmacies, distributors and hospitals; licensing or royalties: royalties and collaboration revenue from licensed products

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: develops and markets branded biologic and small-molecule drugs sold to pharmacies, distributors and hospitals; OEM / manufacturer: manufactures biologics and gene therapy in own facilities from purchased raw materials

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Latin America, Middle East and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: enzyme therapies, peptide and gene therapies, and small-molecule drugs for rare diseases

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: specialty pharmacies and wholesalers/distributors; direct sales: sales to hospitals, national health systems and treatment centers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: drugs and gene therapies requiring FDA, EMA and other regulatory approval, pricing and reimbursement rules
